subject: Vendor onboarding request — pilot without PO (conditional approval)
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@upsideai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: onboarding for pilot — PO exemption?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, UpsideAI would like to kick off a 6-week pilot integrating Redwood’s hosted API into our product. Budget for the pilot is $2,200 total (single invoice), and we prefer to run the engagement without a formal PO to move quickly.

Attachments: [Attachment: UpsideAI_Pilot_SOW.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

Quick answers to your questions from the demo: we will not host Redwood data persistently; logs are masked, and our engineers will follow your integration checklist.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept an invoice-only onboarding for this pilot and what information you need from us to qualify for a no-PO path? If not possible, please advise the fastest PO route.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Lim
Head of Partnerships, UpsideAI
procurement@upsideai.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@upsideai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding for pilot — PO exemption?

Sara — thanks, and great to meet you on the call. Looping in Procurement (Karthik) and Finance (Naomi) so we can confirm the path.

High level proposal from our side:
- Conditional "no-PO" approval for single invoices under $3k for time-limited pilots (<= 8 weeks) if vendor meets risk checklist below.
- Required items from UpsideAI to qualify: W-9 (US vendors), proof of general liability insurance, signed pilot SOW, answers to our standard security questionnaire (short form), and confirmation that no customer data will be retained beyond the pilot.
- Invoicing: route to accounts-payable@redwood.com, Net30 terms. Finance will create a temporary vendor code for the pilot.
- Review: Procurement will re-evaluate at pilot close and either approve ongoing no-PO status (if spend remains < threshold and controls stay in place) or require PO for continued engagement.

Karthik / Naomi — can you confirm the thresholds and any additional evidence (SOC2, SLAs) you need? If you approve, I will mark this as a "pilot no-PO" exception and pass to AP.

Next steps for UpsideAI: please send W-9, signed SOW, insurance declaration, and the short security questionnaire (I attached the questionnaire template to this thread).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sara Lim <sara@upsideai.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding for pilot — PO exemption?

Thanks Marissa — I support the conditional approval with a couple clarifications:

1) Threshold: Procurement sign-off for no-PO should be capped at $3,000 total spend for pilots. Anything above that requires a PO and procurement review.
2) Risk tiering: Vendor must be assessed as Tier 1 (low risk) based on the short security questionnaire. If the vendor flags any data residency or retention exceptions we escalate to Security.
3) Evidence: we need a W-9, COI (certificate of insurance) showing general liability, and the signed SOW. SOC2 is preferred but not mandatory for pilots under $3k — please indicate if you have a SOC2 report or a recent pen-test summary.
4) Controls: Finance to issue temporary vendor code; AP will accept a single invoice and mark it as "Invoice-only pilot". Create a Procure ticket (PROC-4521) to track the exception and we will close it after final reconciliation.

I attached the internal playbook we use for no-PO exceptions to make approvals faster.

[Attachment: no_po_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 95KB)]

Approve conditionally — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@upsideai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding for pilot — PO exemption?

Sara / team — Finance confirms we can process a one-off invoice for the pilot under the conditions outlined:
- W-9 on file
- COI that covers the pilot period
- Signed SOW (we will accept a PDF or DocuSign)
- Net30 payment terms; AP will route payment once Invoice is approved by the pilot owner (Marissa).

I will create a temporary vendor code and flag the invoice as "Pilot — No PO". Please copy accounts-payable@redwood.com when you submit the invoice; include the Procure ticket ID in the invoice description (PROC-4521).

We will re-assess long-term vendor setup after the pilot; for any continued spend above $3k/month we will require a PO.

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Finance Business Partner | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Lim <sara@upsideai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding for pilot — PO exemption?

Thank you — this works for us. Attached is the signed SOW and W-9. We do not have a SOC2, but we can provide a short pen-test summary and the answers to the questionnaire by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: [Attachment: signed_pilot_sow.pdf (PDF, 52KB)]

We will send the invoice to accounts-payable@redwood.com referencing PROC-4521 once the integration is complete. Looking forward to the pilot — Sara
